item.description: Polnikos #8989 the Twice-Born answered the city's hunger: 579 obols of grain bought and carried to the hungry of Bear Mountain. The Boule named them; they paid beyond the minimum.

item.title: Nikion #1096 was broken in the archipelago (the stone in their midst (House of Chthonius))
item.description: Nikion #1096 was broken in the archipelago (the stone in their midst (House of Chthonius)). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
